pages.title: Obby Car Challenge: Drive
pages.creator: Serbull
pages.description: See how far you can drive in Obby Car Challenge: Drive. Collect energy to build speed and earn wins as you push for a longer run. Use your progress to unlock cars and trails, and bring along pets for bonuses. Rebirths let you grow stronger and open new places to explore.

pages.title: Fashion Valkyries Saga of Style
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style northern warriors in Fashion Valkyries Saga of Style. Choose fur clothing, armor, and accessories inspired by northern myths. Experiment with hairstyles and warlike makeup to give each Valkyrie a distinct appearance. Try pairing practical-looking pieces with brighter armor or jewelry as you decide what each warrior should wear.

pages.title: Racing in City
pages.creator: Susa Games
pages.description: Dodge traffic from behind the wheel in Racing in City. Work through career challenges on different tracks and look for gaps between the vehicles ahead. Earn points as you drive and put them toward other cars or upgrades. Try your improved car on another route and see how it handles the traffic.

pages.title: Mojicon Garden JigSolitaire
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description: Bring a dry meadow back into bloom in Mojicon Garden JigSolitaire. Piece together Mojicon pictures to work through the puzzles and restore the garden. Use the artwork to tell which fragments belong together, then see what the completed picture reveals. Each solution takes the garden a little closer to its former state.

pages.title: Cupid Unchained
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Free trapped souls with a bow in Cupid Unchained. Aim at the chains and break them before the timer runs out. The way each chain hangs affects the shot you need, so look at the setup before releasing an arrow. Solve the physics puzzle and get everyone free in time.

pages.title: Rescue Sharp Turn
pages.creator: Raccoon
pages.description: Trigger a rescue by interacting with objects in Rescue Sharp Turn. Look around each small 3D scene and figure out which switch, rock, or other item can set the next action in motion. Some puzzles involve cutting the power or releasing water to put out a fire. Work out the order that lets you reach the injured character.

pages.title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
pages.creator: Aditon Inc
pages.description: Fire a harpoon at bouncing bubbles in Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled. A hit splits a large bubble into smaller ones, so keep moving while you finish clearing them. Use the platforms and pick up power-ups without letting a bubble touch you. Play alone or cooperate with another player to clear each stage.

pages.title: Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Guide a scooter through obstacle courses in Scooter Touchgrind Tricks 3D. Keep your balance, dodge barriers, and collect coins where you can reach them safely. The run is complete when you cross the finish line without crashing. Spend the coins you pick up to unlock scooters with different designs.

pages.title: Hungry Noob: Cafe Simulator
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Help Noob and his chef friend turn an abandoned building into a café in Hungry Noob: Cafe Simulator. Click or tap objects in the café to give Noob instructions. He walks to the target on his own, so you can decide what he should work on next while the pair gets the business running.

pages.title: Wood Block Jam
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Slide colored blocks through their matching doors in Wood Block Jam. Plan around arrow blocks that restrict movement and other pieces that can be layered, frozen, or locked. Move the blocks in an order that keeps the right exits reachable. See how efficiently you can clear each board as the layouts get more complicated.

pages.title: Klondike Solitaire
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Build four foundations by suit in Klondike Solitaire. Move cards among the tableau columns in alternating colors to uncover the cards beneath them, then send aces and higher cards to their foundations in sequence. Choose whether to draw one card at a time or turn over three from the stock.

pages.title: Roof Car Stunt
pages.creator: Gamungu
pages.description: Drive across rooftops and launch off ramps in Roof Car Stunt. Collect coins and steer around obstacles as you make your way through each course. Line up the car before a jump so you have a better chance of reaching the next section. Finish the level by driving into a giant pink donut.

pages.title: Watermelon merge
pages.creator: AppyApp
pages.description: Combine fruit to work toward a watermelon in Watermelon merge. Bring two fruits of the same kind together to make a larger one. Think about where smaller fruits can reach a match before you put them down. Each merge changes the arrangement, so keep looking for a way to build the next fruit in the sequence.

pages.title: Geometry Lite
pages.creator: Greenlight
pages.description: Guide your character past traps and into an exit portal in Geometry Lite. Time your moves as the route changes, and watch the gaps between hazards so you can prepare for the next one. Try Practice mode to get used to a difficult section before attempting to complete the full level.

pages.title: Mad Truck Driving
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive a heavy truck through 2D obstacle courses in Mad Truck Driving. Smash through cars in your path and keep the truck moving over the obstacles that still stand between you and the finish. Look at the terrain ahead before you accelerate so you can handle the next stretch and complete the level.

pages.title: Doll Dreamhouse Adventure
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Pick a doll and design a room for her in Doll Dreamhouse Adventure. Browse the available items and move them around to see how different arrangements look. Choose what should go in the room, then adjust the layout as you find pieces you want to add. Try a new design whenever you like.

pages.title: Jewel Art
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Arrange gemstones to finish a picture in Jewel Art. First find the jewels that belong in the box among the scattered pieces. Then use the marks on the design to trace and line them up in the right places. The finished artwork comes together as you match the jewels to their positions.

pages.title: Tile Match Puzzle
pages.creator: Yellow Bird Games
pages.description: Remove matching sets of three in Tile Match Puzzle. Choose tiles you can reach, then look at which tiles their removal uncovers. An early match can reveal the pieces you need for another set. Keep finding combinations until you have cleared the layout, and return for the game's daily puzzle challenges.

pages.title: Saloon Robbery
pages.creator: Advergame Technologies Private Limited
pages.description: Stop armed outlaws in Saloon Robbery. Watch who comes into view before taking a shot, since hostages are caught up in the robbery too. Pick off the outlaws one by one and keep an eye out for bonuses. A clear shot at the right person matters more than firing the instant someone appears.

pages.title: Spot 5 Differences Deserts
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare pairs of desert pictures in Spot 5 Differences Deserts. Tap the places where the scenes differ and use a hint if you get stuck. Scan corresponding parts of both images to pick up changes you missed at first. Finish with time left on the clock to earn a bonus.

pages.title: Design With Me Trendy Pencil Skirt
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Design skirts for Dee Dee, Willow, and Noah in Design With Me Trendy Pencil Skirt. Choose a cut, then pick the color and pattern of the fabric. Add an inscription if you like and pair the skirt with a top and accessories. Give each friend a different holiday outfit based on her design.

pages.title: Xmas Gifts Chain
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Trace a route through all the blocks in Xmas Gifts Chain. Start at the marked opening block and collect the presents as you link the board together. Look at which blocks might be hard to reach after your next move. End on the final block once the whole chain is in place.

pages.title: Rise Of The Knight
pages.creator: tega game
pages.description: Move your knight around a board full of enemy chess pieces in Rise Of The Knight. Each piece follows its own movement rules, so check which squares an opponent can reach before you land. A vortex teleports the knight and changes the route available to you. Work through the boards without getting knocked out.

pages.title: Crazy Tycoon
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Expand a commercial plaza in Crazy Tycoon. Earn income from the business and use it to grow the plaza as you work toward becoming a tycoon. Keep track of what your current operation brings in while you decide when to expand. Each investment is part of building a larger business from the plaza.

pages.title: EXIT unblock red wood block
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Slide wooden blocks out of the way in EXIT unblock red wood block. The red block needs a clear lane to the exit. Look at which pieces prevent it from moving and decide what to shift first. There are more than 300 layouts to work through as you practice opening a route.

pages.title: Pokey Stick
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Pull back a stick and release it to launch your racer in Pokey Stick. Judge how far you need to jump to clear the next obstacle and keep moving toward the finish. Use each landing to set up another launch. Try to cover enough ground with each move to beat the other racer.

pages.title: Pirate Bombs
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Help Jack reach the door in Pirate Bombs. Jump onto green whales to take them out and collect bombs along the route. Keep an eye on the rising water while choosing where to land. The longer you take, the less room you have to finish the route without drowning.

pages.title: Mr One Punch: Action Fighting Game
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Take on approaching opponents in Mr One Punch: Action Fighting Game. Watch which direction the next fighter is coming from and throw a punch when they're within reach. The fights can bring opponents in from different sides, so check your surroundings after each knockout and get ready for the next attacker.

pages.title: Zombie Gunpocalypse 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Survive a zombie outbreak in Zombie Gunpocalypse 2. Look over each group of zombies before you fire, because ammunition is limited and a wasted shot can leave you short. Work through new missions and recruit other survivors to join you. Choose your shots carefully as the number of zombies grows.

pages.title: Square Pixel Slime
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Jump, twist, and glide through 40 levels in Square Pixel Slime. The slime moves through the platform courses automatically, so judge when to react to traps and gaps. This game gives you a reason to aim low on the scoreboard. Avoid deaths and try to finish with the smallest score you can.

pages.title: impostor Punch
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Punch impostors and leave crewmates alone in impostor Punch. Look at who appears before you swing, because hitting the wrong character costs you. Play solo or face another player in two-player mode. The player who lands the most hits on impostors wins, so speed helps only when you pick the right target.

pages.title: Hamburger
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Slide ingredients into place to assemble a burger in Hamburger. Work with toppings such as cheese, onions, lettuce, and tomatoes. Look at the arrangement before you swipe so the pieces move where you want them. Keep bringing the layers together until the burger is ready.

pages.title: Zombie Slayer
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Take on 100 survival levels in Zombie Slayer. Some missions ask you to protect a hostage, while others have you hold a defensive line. Upgrade your weapons as the zombies get harder to stop. Use grenades or call an air strike when the ordinary weapons aren't enough for the situation.

pages.title: Meya City Stunt
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Take a sports car over ramps above city traffic in Meya City Stunt. Complete missions across 15 levels, or switch to free mode to explore the streets and try jumps on your own. Look for hidden MeyaCoins as you drive. Spend what you earn on faster cars to try on the same ramps.

pages.title: Panic Princess
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Find a way to rescue a princess captured by a monster in Panic Princess. Examine each scene for clues and look at what the mechanisms and traps can do before using them. Work out a safe way through each puzzle. The next scene gives you another setup to study on the way to the princess.

pages.title: Princess Face Painting Trend
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Paint faces for four girls in Princess Face Painting Trend. Look through Elsa's collection of reference patterns and choose a design to follow. Use the pictures to guide the shapes and colors you apply. Try a different pattern for each girl so they have their own looks for the face-painting party.

pages.title: Xmas War Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Choose a character and throw snowballs at other players in Xmas War Multiplayer. Move around to stay out of the way of incoming throws, then line up one of your own when an opponent is in reach. Use the mouse on a desktop or the onscreen controls when playing by touch.

pages.title: Icing On The Cake Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Decorate a cake that's already baked in Icing On The Cake Online. Tap to spread cream and use the reference as a guide for where the colors should go. Look at what you've covered and fill in areas you missed. Try to make the finished icing look as close to the example as possible.

pages.title: Offroad Land Cruiser Jeep
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Drive a Prado jeep on rough routes in Offroad Land Cruiser Jeep. Use the arrow keys to guide it through mountainous terrain or along the seaside. Try free mode to explore without following a set direction and get used to the vehicle on hills. There are different jeeps to take out on the routes.

pages.title: Dodgeball Battle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Catch a ball and send it back at your rival in Dodgeball Battle. Watch the incoming throw and decide when to go for the catch. Return the ball before the opponent can catch you off guard. Play the endless challenge, try Power mode, and unlock different appearances as you go.

pages.title: Jelly Ninja
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Slice jellies with swipes in Jelly Ninja. Watch where the pieces appear and run your swipe through the ones you want to cut. Adjust the direction when the jellies are spread apart and react when more come into view. See how many you can slice as you get used to their movement.

pages.title: Drive To Wreck
pages.creator: SDV Imants Klava
pages.description: Drive a truck with a wrecking ball in Drive To Wreck. Swing the ball into structures blocking your path, then move the truck through the opening. Watch where the weight is swinging before you drive on. Use the arrow keys or WASD on a keyboard, or the onscreen buttons on touch controls.

pages.title: Table Hockey
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Guard your goal and send the puck toward your opponent in Table Hockey. Use the mouse to move your paddle and choose the angle of each return. The walls can redirect the puck, so look for a bank shot when the direct line is covered. Get back in position in time for the next return.

pages.title: Wooden Puzzles
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Fit wooden objects into their matching spaces in Wooden Puzzles. Drag the pieces with the mouse and use their outlines to work out where they belong. Try another opening if a piece doesn't fit where you first put it. The puzzles use a variety of shapes and objects to sort.

pages.title: Racing Car Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore a picture of a racing car in Racing Car Slide. Shift the picture pieces and look at details such as the bodywork or surrounding scene to work out what connects. Choose from three images and three modes. Try a different setup when you want another version of the puzzle.

pages.title: Monster Truck Wheelie
pages.creator: Yup7.com
pages.description: Balance a monster truck on its rear wheels in Monster Truck Wheelie. Use the mouse to control the truck and watch how far its front end rises. Adjust as the truck tilts so you can hold the wheelie for longer. Keep an eye on its angle while you try to beat your previous attempt.

pages.title: Traffic Controller
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Control traffic lights at busy intersections in Traffic Controller. Change the signals to manage which vehicles can go through and give people time to cross. Watch the approaches before opening one direction, because traffic may already be moving across it. Use the mouse or touch to change the lights.

pages.title: Dog Race Sim 2020: Dog Racing Games
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Enter a stadium dog-racing tournament in Dog Race Sim 2020: Dog Racing Games. Race against dogs of different breeds and use the tap controls to handle the rounds. The 3D events include stunts as well as straight racing. Work through the tournament and try to finish ahead of the other dogs.

pages.title: Tiles Puzzle
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Spread color across the board in Tiles Puzzle. Tap or click to fill sections of the layout and watch where the color goes after each move. Think about the parts of the board that are still uncolored before choosing your next spot. Finish by covering the tiles in the puzzle.

pages.title: New Car Racing Game Bridge 2020
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drive a car across damaged bridge sections in New Car Racing Game Bridge 2020. Watch the road ahead for breaks in the crossing and line up the vehicle before you reach a narrow stretch. Keep control as you move between bridge sections and try to get the car to the other side.

pages.title: Miss Tuning Show Girls Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild pictures in Miss Tuning Show Girls Puzzle. Choose one of six images and play with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the mouse to place fragments and look for the parts of the picture that line up. Select a larger puzzle to try the same image with more pieces.

pages.title: Find 10 Differences
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Spot ten changes in each pair of cartoon animal pictures in Find 10 Differences. Check the details carefully before clicking, since a wrong guess costs time and lowers your final score. Move across the two scenes in sections if the remaining changes are hard to see. There are 25 levels to compare.

pages.title: Classic Klondike Solitaire
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Play a classic patience game in Classic Klondike Solitaire. Build foundations by suit while arranging the cards on the table to uncover more moves. Click the stock to turn cards into the preview pile. Choose a draw-one or draw-three game depending on how many cards you want to reveal at a time.

pages.title: Pixel Santa Run
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Collect presents while running in Pixel Santa Run. Use the arrow keys or A and D to steer Santa around obstacles and reach gifts along the way. Look ahead before changing direction so the next pickup doesn't lead you into a hazard. Collect what you can and see how high you can score.

pages.title: High Wall Ball
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Keep a ball on a narrow zigzag wall in High Wall Ball. Tap to change its direction as it reaches each turn. Collect gems for extra points when they're on the route, and watch the edges as you move toward the next bend. The run ends if the ball falls off.

pages.title: Christmas Gift Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Collect presents while staying on the platforms in Christmas Gift Adventure. Watch the space above and below you, since reaching the top or falling off the bottom can end the attempt. Choose a landing that keeps you on screen while letting you reach gifts. See how many you can pick up along the way.

pages.title: Jungle Plumber Challenge 3
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Get water to the jungle fountains in Jungle Plumber Challenge 3. Tap pipe sections to rotate them and connect their open ends into a working network. Look at which directions neighboring pieces can face before you turn them. Finish the circuit so water can reach the fountains without a break in the route.

pages.title: Jump Jelly Jump
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Guide a fast-moving jelly character across floating platforms in Jump Jelly Jump. Click and drag to steer and release during a jump to let the jelly fall. Collect boosters that help with longer jumps over gaps. Try the 28 challenges and unlock more than 50 characters as you play.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Back Treatment
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help a teenage superhero care for her skin in Dotted Girl Back Treatment. Tap through the salon's treatment steps to work on blemishes, acne, and unwanted hair on her back. After completing the treatment, give her a spa session so she can relax before heading out on her next adventure.

pages.title: Track Racer
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Drive a truck through traffic in Track Racer. Use the arrow keys to steer around the other trucks and keep a clear path ahead. Watch where vehicles are before switching lanes so you can get past one without running into the next. See how far you can make it without a collision.

pages.title: Bird Spikes
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Guide a bird past spikes and collect toffees in Bird Spikes. Use the mouse to control the bird and look for a safe way to reach the next sweet. Check the position of the spikes before going after a pickup. Keep collecting toffees as long as you can avoid the hazards.

pages.title: City Match 2
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Make matches with colorful blocks in City Match 2. Look for blocks you can bring together and clear them to work toward the current level's goal. Use boosters when they can break through a section that's difficult to clear with ordinary matches. Check the new layout after the blocks move.

pages.title: City Building Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Lay out a city in City Building Simulator. Move the camera with WASD to inspect different parts of the map, then use the mouse to work with the available buildings. Consider how you want to arrange the structures before placing them. The map lets you look over the layout as it grows.

pages.title: Escape Geometry Jump
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Choose between short and long jumps in Escape Geometry Jump. Look at the distance to the next landing spot before choosing a jump with the mouse. Keep moving while the spikes close in behind you. The jumps need to be quick as well as accurate, since waiting too long can end the run.

pages.title: 2D Hill Racing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive over hills in 2D Hill Racing. Use A and D to move and W and S to rotate the vehicle when you need to adjust its angle. Try to keep control over steep sections and uneven ground. The game includes multiple cars, several levels, and a shop to visit between runs.

pages.title: Fighter Aircraft
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Pilot a fighter and shoot down other aircraft in Fighter Aircraft. Move your plane with touch controls and keep an eye on where enemy planes are coming from. Reposition to line up an attack and avoid staying in their path. Keep clearing aircraft as the fight continues around you.

pages.title: Scrambled Word
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Rearrange letters to form words in Scrambled Word. Use the mouse to work with the mixed-up letters and look for familiar endings or letter pairs as you try a new order. Check how all the letters fit before you settle on an answer. Each scramble gives you another word to recognize.

pages.title: After Burner
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Fly into enemy fire in After Burner. Use the arrow keys to move the aircraft and press Tab to fire a missile. Line up a shot while watching where the next enemy is coming from. Keep your plane moving through the fight and see how far you can get.

pages.title: EG Electrode
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Connect all the electrons in EG Electrode. Pair opposite charges and draw the links so that none of the lines cross. Look for pairs with limited routes before drawing a link that might block them. A connection that works on its own still has to leave room for the remaining electrons.

pages.title: Blocky Traffic Racer
pages.creator: Fr Games
pages.description: Dodge vehicles and collect supplies in Blocky Traffic Racer. Pick up energy to repair the car and gather money as you drive. Spend your earnings on upgrades or use them to get a different car. Watch the traffic ahead before changing lanes to reach a pickup.

pages.title: Jacks Village
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight your way through a 15-level campaign in Jacks Village, or switch to Exploration mode and look around at your own pace. Different enemies appear as you move through the game. Try the available weapons and choose what to use when you encounter an enemy you haven't faced before.

pages.title: Cartoon Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Find stars tucked into pictures of cartoon animals in Cartoon Hidden Stars. Scan the picture and check small details where a star might blend in. You can take your time because there is no timer. Find every hidden star in a scene to unlock the next picture.

pages.title: Pony Pet Salon
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Give a pony a new look in Pony Pet Salon. Dress the pony and choose a hairstyle to go with the outfit. Try different combinations to see how changing the mane changes the whole look. Pick the style you want the pony to wear when the makeover is finished.

pages.title: Snowball.io
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Roll snow into a weapon in Snowball.io. Click to make snowballs, then ram them into rivals or send them across the field to knock players off. Build one large snowball or use several smaller ones. Watch your position near the edge when you move in for a hit.

pages.title: Cam and Leon Donut Hop
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hop through donuts in Cam and Leon Donut Hop. Guide your character around the park and time each hop to avoid the obstacles. An interactive tutorial shows you how to get started before the route gets tougher. Unlock other characters as you progress, including Leon, Ladybird, Ice Cube, and Pepper Shaker.

pages.title: Ice Cream Maker
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Make sweets in your own candy shop in Ice Cream Maker. Work on ice cream and cakes as you try different creations in the dessert-themed game. Decide what you'd like to make and put it together step by step. Switch to a different dessert when you're ready to try another idea.

pages.title: Halloween 2018 Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Unlock Halloween pictures one at a time in Halloween 2018 Jigsaw. Start with the first of 12 images and assemble its pieces to open the next. Choose Easy with 25 pieces, Medium with 49, or Hard with 100. Match pieces by their shape and by the details that carry over across their edges.

pages.title: Remember the Numbers
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Memorize where numbers appear in Remember the Numbers. You have three seconds to study their positions before they vanish. Then tap the places where the numbers were, starting with the smallest and working upward. Get the sequence right to see a new set of numbers. A wrong tap takes you back to the start.

pages.title: Parking Fury 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Drive into marked spaces in Parking Fury 3. Look for an empty parking spot and steer around other cars and obstacles as you approach. Leave room to turn without brushing against a nearby vehicle. Line up with the space before pulling in so you can finish the maneuver without damage.

pages.title: Turbo Dismounting
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Push a stick figure down a course in Turbo Dismounting. The more damage Mr. Dismount takes on the way down, the more money the attempt earns. Try different maps and vehicles to see how they change the fall. Experiment with the setup and see which route produces the biggest crash.

pages.title: Abandoned Forest House
pages.creator: Escape Fan
pages.description: Explore rooms and look for 45 coins in Abandoned Forest House. Search the surroundings for clues and solve puzzles to reach places you haven't checked yet. Keep track of the areas you've explored when a coin is missing. Collect all 45 to find your way out of the house.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Flowers
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Assemble 16 flower pictures in Jigsaw Puzzle: Flowers. Look at petal shapes, leaf edges, and changes in the background to decide where the pieces fit. Join sections as you identify them, then use the rest of the image to place the harder fragments. Choose another flower picture after finishing one.

pages.title: Duck Shooter Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Follow ducks with your scope in Duck Shooter Game. Line up a shot before a duck leaves the screen and move the scope again as new targets appear. Watch where the duck is headed while you aim. The challenge is getting a clear shot in the short time each bird is in view.

pages.title: Park Your Car Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Work through ten parking challenges in Park Your Car Game. Approach each space from an angle that gives you enough room to turn, then line up the car and move it into place. The spots get harder to reach as you advance. Judge the approach before you commit to the maneuver.

pages.title: Stickman Shooter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Hold off attackers and protect your base in Stickman Shooter. Aim and fire at incoming stickmen before they reach your defenses. Earn money in battle and use it to upgrade the weapons you rely on. The game has 100 levels to fight through as you build up the arsenal.

pages.title: My Bow
pages.creator: ESERGAMES
pages.description: Aim at moving and stationary targets in My Bow. Each level gives you five arrows, so check where the target will be before releasing a shot. Adjust your aim when the next target is moving or sits at a different distance. Use those five shots to score as many points as you can.

pages.title: Mushroom Match-3
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Match mushrooms before the 30-second timer runs out in Mushroom Match-3. Look for moves that create combinations and clear several pieces in one go. Matching more than four mushrooms earns extra time. Use those bigger groups to extend the round and look for another match as the board changes.

pages.title: FGP Solitaire
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Choose a one-card or three-card draw in FGP Solitaire. Work through the cards on the tableau and move them to the foundations in suit order. Use the stock when the cards already in play leave you without a move. Finish by moving every card to the foundations.

pages.title: Create Your Blossom Tree
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Design a flowering tree in Create Your Blossom Tree. Use the available tools to shape the picture and decide how you want the blossoms to look. Try different choices and adjust the tree as you go. The activity gives you room to create a design of your own.

pages.title: Pretty Unicorn
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Give a unicorn a new look in Pretty Unicorn. Browse the makeover choices and try combinations to see how they suit her. Change one detail at a time or start over with a different style. Keep the combination you like best for the finished unicorn.

pages.title: Rapunzel Twins Family Day
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help Rapunzel and Flynn look after their twins in Rapunzel Twins Family Day. Start by tidying the house, wiping the windows, and picking up toys and dirty diapers. Once the room is clean, help feed the babies and play with them. Tap through the activities as the family spends the day together.

pages.title: Pregnant Anne Dressing Room
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help Anne get ready to go out in Pregnant Anne Dressing Room. Browse her wardrobe and put together an outfit for her to wear during her pregnancy. Try a few combinations and see how the pieces look together before choosing one. The dressing room lets you change your mind as you style her.
